verdict.rationale: Highnote's docs show a broad GraphQL API covering card issuance, spend controls, disputes, ledger, webhooks, and even a Test environment that 'replicates the full functionality of the Live environment' — suggesting the API is the primary surface and the dashboard mirrors it, not vice versa. However, there is no explicit statement that every dashboard/UI action (e.g., manual reviews, reconciliation views) has a direct API equivalent, and no independent/third-party confirmation of full parity. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement, coverage of any admin/dashboard-only workflows, and independent verification beyond vendor docs.
